items.title: Josiah Gluck interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 13, 2022
items.q: I’ve worked with Lenny a lot and we’ll always record the theme on a Saturday morning when the band is rehearsing

ctx.x: That’s okay. What’s your relationship like with the house band? Is Lenny Pickett like a guy that you had this important relationship with over the years?

Oh yes. I mean I’ve known Lenny for a very long time and parenthetically I wasn’t working with Lenny at the time but right out of college the studio that I worked for starting in 1982 — no excuse me 1981 — one of our main clients was the SNL house band. And so some of these guys I’ve known, some of these cats I’ve known since 1981. The fall of 1981. But you know the band would come in and do rehearsals. No I mean I’ve worked with Lenny a lot and we’ll always record the theme on a Saturday morning when the band is…

Do you have — of course you have the house band and then you have the live music guest. Do you have something in your head, in your hearing that matches them in the sense that overall volume, bass volume, all that kind of thing?
